thread:
customer_alex: Hey support, our job-run tool calls are failing only from the TS SDK. Works in Python. Getting a schema validation error.
paul_support: Sorry to hear that, can you paste the error and a tiny repro?
customer_alex: Error from Redwood API: 400 ToolCallSchemaError: priority: value not in enum ['LOW','MEDIUM','HIGH'] (received "low")
customer_alex: Repro: JS/TS SDK call snippet:
```js
await client.callTool('run_job', { job_id: 123, priority: 'low' })
```
customer_alex: Python version that works:
```py
client.call_tool('run_job', { 'job_id': 123, 'priority': 'LOW' })
```
paul_support: Hmm, thanks. Any chance the TS client is lowercasing enums automatically? What SDK versions?
customer_alex: TS @ 0.38.1, Python @ 0.39.0. We didn't normalize.
maya_eng-ml: @paul_support @sam_eng-runtime tagging infra — schema validation is strict enum match. We think TS serializer might coerce enums to lowercase for some types.
maya_eng-ml: Can you share request payload captured by the backend? (headers okay to omit)
support-bot: Uploaded request log: /logs/req-1819876543.json (internal)
sam_eng-runtime: I pulled the log: payload body shows {"args": {"job_id":123, "priority":"low"}, "tool":"run_job"}
sam_eng-runtime: The tool schema is enums uppercase. We validate strictly which is why it fails.
paul_support: Is this a regression? Any recent change in serializer behavior?
maya_eng-ml: We rolled a TS SDK serialization fix last month but it shouldn't touch enum casing. @julia_devex can you check SDK changelog?
julia_devex: Checking... TS SDK 0.38.0 included a PR to normalize string tokens for HTTP headers, but not enums. 0.38.1 only had a bundling tweak.
customer_alex: Workaround: we uppercased priority in our app and calls succeed. But we have many clients so would prefer SDK fix.
sam_eng-runtime: Short-term we can make schema validation case-insensitive for enums for tool calls from SDKs to avoid breaking customers. Medium-term fix in TS SDK to preserve casing.
maya_eng-ml: Agree. @sam_eng-runtime can you do a hotfix on validation? If so we'll patch and notify the customer.
sam_eng-runtime: I'll open a rollback-safe PR to accept case-insensitive enum values for toolcall validation. Target: patch release today.
paul_support: Great. @customer_alex we'll follow up when rollout is live. Sorry for the disruption :hand_over_mouth: 
customer_alex: thanks — appreciate fast triage. Also logging this as a support ticket: SUP-2026.
maya_eng-ml: Todo: create regression test covering enum casing across Python/TS/Go SDKs. Assigning to eng-ml.
julia_devex: Also update TS SDK to stop lowercasing enums if that's happening. I'll add a changelog entry.
sam_eng-runtime: Patch merged, deploying now :hammer_and_wrench: 
support-bot: Deploy succeeded: rollout 2% -> 100% in 15m. Patch id: p-2026-case-insensitive-enums
paul_support: Can you confirm customer calls now succeed?
support-bot: Post-deploy healthcheck: run_job tool acceptance tests: OK
customer_alex: Verified — our TS client calls now return 200. Thanks everyone! :tada:
paul_support: Closing ticket after verifying with customer. Followups: SDK fix and test coverage.
